application.name: SPI Triage
application.meta_description: Native Authentik OIDC for the SPI queue operator UI. Worker APIs and webhooks keep separate machine credentials.

operator.nativeRole: List queue and cancel eligible pending jobs only; active/Wait/publication guards remain in the backend.

session.storage: Bounded process memory; only opaque host-only Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies reach the browser
session.refresh: No refresh token is requested or stored. Expiry requires a fresh native OIDC roundtrip.
session.revocation: No immediate IdP-group revocation claim: session ends by verified ID-token expiry, local logout, or UI restart.
